main_text.p: facere potest videri. Sic enim verba ejus habent, non censuisse Solonem, eum certum modum ferendarū legum novarum posteris præscriberet, thesmothetas legum curatores forte jam designatos, antequàm ad ineundum magistratum admitterentur, bis oportere examini subjici, in senatu primum, deinde in judicio, leges autem ipsas temerè, & sine ullo examine recipi æquum esse. Ecce, θεσμοθέτας, inquit, τὰς ἐπὶ τὰς νόμως [?] κληρωθέντας δὶς δοκιμασθέντας ἀρχειν. Res videtur esse clarissima, & fortitò thesmothetas, qui in numero ix-virùm erant, fuisse designatos, & institutum à Solone manasse. Verùm obstat sententiæ huic illustris, atque, ut, quod res est, dicam, irrefragabilis autoritas Aristotelis, viri maximi, quæ extat eodem loco, quem antè notavi, politicorum lib. ii. capite 10. Ibi namque de νομοθεσίας differens Philosophus perspicuis verbis affirmat, Solonem leges scribentem non senatum modò Areo-pagi, sed morem etiam eligendi magi-stratus, uti antè in civitate fuerat, reli-[illegible, ~4 letters], judicia autem cum plebe communicata, in quibus sortis esset usus, [illegible, ~3 letters]gendum jus plebis, cum eorum ratio

page.notes: Doubtful or damaged readings: the initial letters of the line beginning "gendum" are hidden by a red stain and are marked illegible. The line ending "reli-" is partly hidden; the second half of the word is illegible. Greek νόμως and the Greek word-forms in the Aristotle quotation are copied as seen and may contain small errors; the first Greek word is marked [?]. The "ix-virùm" and "ii." forms are kept as printed. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. Left margin: red-stained fragments of printed marks (near the lower left) that cannot be read as notes; not transcribed. Right edge: show-through of text from the reverse side; not transcribed. No catchword or gathering signature is legible.
